method: Use actual NoiseBasedChunkGenerator.getBaseHeight OCEAN_FLOOR_WG columns, including vanilla three-dimensional terrain and noise caves. Measure slope as the magnitude of centered X/Z height differences sampled four blocks either side of each bank column.
selection: For each seed, scan X/Z from -4096 to 4096 in steps of 32/48. Retain the first 80 mountain-lake bank columns with nominal offset height 20..60 and actual water depth 5..45. Separately inspect the first 80 deep columns with nominal offset height at most 20.
regression: For each tested seed, require sufficient real columns, a varied deep floor, and median bank slope between 1 and 2 inclusive.
limitations: These are bounded seeded samples, not global quantiles or per-column slope guarantees. Vanilla three-dimensional noise and cave openings retain steeper local cliffs. The extra lake offset stops at its nominal fifty-block-deep target; underlying vanilla noise, continentalness, erosion, and cavities can leave shallower or deeper actual floor columns.
